'''October 2001 Sydney tournament (after 14 October)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Sydney, Australia in October 2001. [[Jason Baretta]] won it. It is known from Jason Baretta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3081">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-sydey-staringblacksunfleet-grapplinghookd3081/ sydey-staringblacksunfleet-grapplinghook], DeckTech (jason "zwitter" baretta, 29 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-29-sydey-staringblacksunfleet-grapplinghookd3081/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' October 2001
* '''Site:''' Sydney, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Jason Baretta]]
